LanguageData.AAW_AutoriserLabourDesc: If on, harnessed beasts pulling a plow will turn the earth of this growing zone.\n\nLeave at least three cells between the zone and any fence. A zone right against a fence, or enclosed inside an animal pen, can leave the colonist leading the animal going back and forth: it gets released on the wrong side of the barrier, where it cannot reach its work.
LanguageData.AAW_AlerteHarnaisDesc: Draft work is waiting, but these beasts have no draft harness to don and none is available. Craft draft harnesses at a crafting spot or tailoring bench.
LanguageData.AAW_ToggleLabourDesc: Whether this beast may plow. Turn off to keep this particular beast off the plow; it drops its plow at once. The per-zone "Allow plowing" toggle still decides where plowing happens.
LanguageData.AAW_ToggleCharretteDesc: Whether this beast may pull a cart to haul loose items to storage. Turn off to keep it off cart duty; it delivers any load already aboard, then drops the cart.
LanguageData.AAW_ToggleDeneigementDesc: Whether this beast may pull a scraper to clear the snow-clear area. Turn off to keep it off snow duty; it drops its scraper at once.
LanguageData.AAW_ReglageEspeces: Which species can be harnessed. Pack animals are already ticked, which covers most modded beasts without you doing anything; tick anything else you want harnessed, or untick what you do not. Ticking a species only makes the task switches appear on it — you still turn each animal's work on yourself.\n\nSorted by body size, largest first. Type to filter.
